name: Sheraton Mexico City Maria Isabel
positioning: City hotel on Reforma Avenue near downtown Mexico City, officially Sheraton Maria Isabel Mexico City Reforma, with Angel-view suites and penthouses and a Sheraton Club Lounge
best_for: City travelers who want a central base on Reforma Avenue
Guests who want a suite or penthouse with an Angel view

facts.text: The hotel has a central location near downtown.
The Penthouse is on a high floor with an Angel view and a balcony.
Some Business Deluxe rooms in the Reforma Tower have a Reforma Avenue view.
The club lounge offers a hot buffet, snacks, and coffee and tea.
Rooms have Sheraton Signature Sleep Experience beds.
Rooms have high-speed Wi-Fi and a work desk with plug-in panels.
The hotel offers a 24-hour room service menu.
Rooms offer free water and a minibar.
Some room types have jet tubs.
Rooms have a coffee and tea maker.

highlights.text: The Malmaison Penthouse is a two-bedroom penthouse suite with an Angel view and a balcony.
The Marco Polo Presidential is a three-bedroom presidential suite with an Angel view.
The Corner Suite has an Angel view and club lounge access.
The hotel offers views of the bustling Reforma Avenue.
The Sheraton Club Lounge is a space for Sheraton Club guests and upper elite tiers to work, connect or relax.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the older property's traditional decor may feel dated to some guests.
WhataHotel notes the hotel sits in a busy commercial district.
